title: Remove 'crack' references, add value proposition tagline, and update pool to pool decks

requirements.text: Remove all instances of the words 'crack' and 'cracks' from all website content across all frontend components (HeroSection, ServicesSection, AboutSection, ContactSection, Footer)
acceptanceCriteria: No instances of 'crack' or 'cracks' appear in any component text

requirements.text: Add the tagline 'Affordable, Reasonable prices, great quality from start to finish' to the HeroSection component, displayed prominently near the main company tagline

quotes: Affordable, Reasonable prices, great quality from start to finish

acceptanceCriteria: The tagline 'Affordable, Reasonable prices, great quality from start to finish' is visible in the hero section
The tagline is styled consistently with the existing hero section design
The tagline is positioned appropriately within the hero layout

requirements.text: Update the HeroSection component to change all references from 'pool' to 'pool decks' in the tagline and descriptive text
acceptanceCriteria: All instances of 'pool' in the hero section are updated to 'pool decks'
The updated text reads naturally and grammatically correct

constraints: Preserve the existing visual design and layout structure
Maintain consistency with the industrial-modern theme
nonGoals: Changing any polyaspartic terminology back to epoxy
